title: Firework profile
description: A straight-line op program plus its default attributes: data/<namespace>/fireworks/<name>.json. Ranges mirror Attributes and FireworkLimits; values outside them are clamped by the runtime, so the schema flags them instead. An unknown op is a hard error; an unknown attribute is kept and ignored.

attributes.description: The open attribute bag. Known keys are typed below; unknown keys are allowed on purpose so newer content still loads on an older build.

flight.speed.description: Blocks per tick. Overrides the launch op's speed when present.

flight.gravity.description: Downward acceleration per tick; 0 keeps the rocket level.

flight.max_speed.description: Velocity cap per tick; 0 freezes the rocket in place.

flight.drag.description: Velocity multiplier per tick; 1.0 means no drag.

collide.description: Explode on the first block or entity collision.

decorative.description: Immune to damage and ignored by entity targeting.

afterglow.description: Ticks the entity survives after its program ends.

max.depth.description: Maximum nested split depth; 0 forbids children.

max.children.description: Maximum children this rocket may spawn over its whole life.

trail.interval.description: Emit a trail particle every N ticks.

trail.colors.description: Trail colours; one is chosen at random per particle.

launch.sound.description: Sound played once when the rocket is created.

fuse.ticks.description: Tick offset used by every instruction with `at: "fuse"`; the crafting table raises it to stretch flight time.

sound.id.description: Overrides the id of every sound op.

light.ticks.description: Overrides the ticks of every light op.

show.description: The show a burst bakes: an installed id, or an inline show document.

op.description: One timed instruction. `at` places it on the frame's tick timeline, `when` gates it on physics, nesting is call/end, children are spawn.

at.description: Ticks after the frame starts. "fuse" reads the fuse.ticks attribute. Omitted means the same tick as the previous instruction.

when.description: Optional physics guard: the op runs at `at` only once this holds. Nesting a call does not reset it.

height.description: Wait until position.y is above this.

below.description: Wait until position.y is below this.

collision.description: Wait until the rocket has collided.

timeout.description: Give up waiting this many ticks after `at` and run the op anyway.

direction.description: launch only. An attribute override wins when flight.direction.mode is set. relative reads flight.direction.yaw/pitch from the launcher's heading.

vector.description: launch only: the direction when direction is vector.

speed.description: launch only: initial speed in blocks per tick. An attribute override wins.

program.description: call/spawn only: the program to run or split into.

spread.description: spawn only. Ignored: a child now flies along its own launch op and flight.direction.* attributes. Still accepted so existing data packs load.

delay.description: spawn only: ticks before each child appears.
